messages:
marcus.s: Hey folks, new POC request from MedBridge — they want a 5-day eval and asked for SOC2 artifacts + full pen-test report upload. They're insisting on a single ZIP in our dataroom. Can we define the upload flow and responsibilities?
sofia.sales: Do they want raw PDFs with IPs/hosts? We usually offer a redacted package + an attestation letter.
tim.security: They explicitly asked for raw reports for internal risk review. We should insist on presigned uploads and a short TTL. Also need a vendor-signed pen-test attestation before we ingest.
olivia.legal: I'll coordinate the vendor letter. Proposal: vendor signs our standard attestation, which includes scope, retention, and redaction request process. I'll add a clause that Redwood only stores raw reports for 21 days post-upload unless customer extends. Thoughts? :thinking_face:
hana.eng: Ops can create a scoped presign bucket path under `medbridge/poc-uploads/` with 14-day object lifecycle. We can also enable audit logs on that prefix. Scan window — suggest Wednesday 01:00-03:00 PT for external scans to reduce interference.
lee.devrel: Buyer asked if we can act as a liaison to the external vendor for signature (they prefer not to). There's a small coordination fee for that service. We should be explicit on quotes.
sofia.sales: Pricing: add line items: "POC reserved capacity", "Compliance ingestion (14d) — waived for first 7 days", "Vendor liaison (optional)". Keeps sales ops clean.
tim.security: Pen-test attestation must include: exact scope (CIDR/hostnames), environments (staging IDs), allowed test types (external/internal), and redaction policy. Suggest the snippet below be included in the vendor letter.

```
Required attestation snippet:
- Scope: staging subnet(s) and listed hostnames; tests limited to agreed CIDRs
- Retention: Redwood stores raw reports for 14 days after upload
- Redaction: Customer may request redaction within 10 days; Redwood will apply redaction and re-issue redacted bundle
- Distribution: Attestation letter may be shared with third parties
```

marcus.s: Good. Can Olivia add that and send to vendor + buyer? I'll confirm POC start date depending on capacity.
ops-bot: presign-ready: https://files.redwood.test/presign/medbridge-poc?ttl=7d (example) — generated at 1748210125. :white_check_mark:

olivia.legal: Uploaded draft attestation to the dataroom and pinged vendor. Also added a short clause: "Redwood acts only as custodian of uploaded evidence unless a formal vendor-liaison engagement is signed."
hana.eng: Confirmed presigned path and lifecycle. Will set lifecycle to 14 days but we can mark first 7 days complimentary. Canary reserved nodes available for Wed start, will confirm by EOD.
sofia.sales: Sending updated quote with the compliance line items now. I'll include vendor-liaison as optional with a flat $1,200 fee.
marcus.s: Thanks — final todo: vendor signs attestation, ops shares final presign URL, sales sends updated quote to buyer. If vendor needs Redwood to sign anything else to accept uploads, flag it.
lee.devrel: One note from buyer: they want the option for us to redact before we hand the bundle to their procurement. They'll supply a redaction template. We'll accept as long as it's within the 10-day window.
marcus.s: Great. Closing loop once vendor signs. Will update thread with final presign URL. :pray:
